create.name: Tanis Fishman
create.bio:
Tanis Fishman is a Calgary-based teacher of Yoga Nidra and contemplative practice, and the founder of School of Sankalpa. Before any of this she competed as a skier on the Canadian national team, and she describes carrying big questions about existence through those years without a language for them. Her study of Yoga Nidra started at Bihar Yoga Bharati in India, rooted in the Satyananda line, and grew into more than two decades of guiding practices, writing scripts and training others to lead them.

Over time her focus has widened from Yoga Nidra alone to a broader enquiry into consciousness, the sacred and how we can tell what is true in our own experience. She now teaches through recorded courses on Yoga Nidra, the five koshas and the meaning of Sankalpa, live online group meditations that work with a shared field, and small retreats held with Joanna Haines, the next at 42 Acres in Somerset, England. She has kept a large archive of her earlier Yoga Nidra recordings free to stream, and many of her longer practices are also on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Awakening From Our Sleep: Yoga Nidra Training & Immersion
courses.description: A self-paced course filmed over five live days, with fifteen lectures, twelve full Yoga Nidra practices and two manuals. It covers where the practice comes from, how a session is built and paced, and how to guide others, so it suits both personal study and people who want to lead Yoga Nidra.

courses.title: The Inward Path
courses.description: A seven-week recorded course that slows Yoga Nidra down and spends a week on each stage, using the five koshas of yogic teaching as its map. Each week pairs teaching with practice and reflection.

courses.title: A Path to Sankalpa
courses.description: A self-paced course in five modules on Sankalpa, which Tanis treats as far more than setting an intention. It looks at desire, identity and inner recognition, and at how something known inwardly comes to shape everyday choices.

courses.title: Templed Retreat, Somerset
courses.description: A six-night retreat at 42 Acres in Somerset, co-led with Joanna Haines, mixing meditation, silence, walking, conversation and time on the land. One day is set aside for exploring Glastonbury on your own. Prices vary by room type.

free_resources.title: Tanis Fishman on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Long-form guided Yoga Nidra practices from Tanis, several running close to an hour, including journeys through the koshas. Free to listen in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Free Yoga Nidra Recordings
free_resources.description: An archive of Yoga Nidra practices Tanis recorded over many years, listed from oldest to newest so you can hear her style change. Every recording is free to stream.

free_resources.title: Meditation & Yoga Nidra Resources
free_resources.description: Free written guidance for beginners on sitting practice and on getting the most from a Yoga Nidra recording, plus short explainers on Sankalpa, the koshas, witnessing and visualisation.
